name: ancient_dna
headline_stat: mapped fraction vs. fragment length; whether damage-induced mismatches inflate MAPQ penalties

construction.description: No synthetic reference — uses human chr1 (T1) unchanged. Simulated reads use gargammel to produce authentic aDNA damage characteristics: C→T deamination at 5' ends, G→A at 3' ends (Briggs model), short fragment length distribution 30-80 bp.

simulation.notes: Command shown is illustrative for one parameter combination (35bp, high damage). acquire.py will run gargammel once per (fragment_length, damage_level) combination. See AGENTS.md for the full parameter sweep protocol. Single-end reads typical for aDNA.

sweep.notes: 9 combinations total (3 lengths x 3 damage levels). Report mapped fraction and positional accuracy for each combination.

truth.eval_notes: Validate damage profile with mapDamage2 before scoring alignments. Mapped fraction vs. fragment length is the primary diagnostic; MAPQ calibration for damaged reads is secondary.
